question_text: Write an ANSI SQL query to compute total high-confidence inferences and average latency per model version from `model_predictions_14`.
correct_answer:
SELECT model_version, COUNT(*) AS total_inferences, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 2) AS avg_latency
FROM model_predictions_14
WHERE confidence_score >= 0.90
GROUP BY model_version
ORDER BY avg_latency ASC;
answer_explanation: Filters predictions with high confidence, groups by model version, and calculates average inference latency.
